sourceText:
Top 10 crepes fillings (Crepes with Salmon filling)
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Monday, October 19, 2020 - 5:41pm

Ingredients




1 oz Cured Salmon
2 tbsp Philadelphia Cream Cheese
1 cucumber
Dill

Preparation

1 Slice the Cured Salmon. Find the recipe how to make the Cured Salmon in the description. 2 Spread the Cream Cheese over the Crepe 3 Place a cucumber and a slice of salmon at about the center of the crepe 4 Season with fresh dill 5 Wrap it up in an envelope style. Honestly it looks more like a burrito to me. Here is a quick life hack: you can move the filling a little bit if you are experiencing some troubles in wrapping up the crepe. 6 Cut the crepe into halves to make them ready for the party. This is delicious.
